title: Maintain consistent daily IT systems monitoring
description: Ensure daily monitoring of all critical IT systems, including the AAC Kenya Server, MCS Server, Advocates/Insurance Server, network connectivity, internet, critical applications and endpoint security. Identify and escalate system failures promptly.

title: Ensure successful completion and verification of scheduled backups
description: Ensure all scheduled daily, weekly and monthly backup jobs are completed and verified successfully. Monitor backup status, storage capacity, backup integrity and retention compliance. Investigate and escalate backup failures immediately.

title: Successfully complete scheduled backup restoration tests
description: Conduct backup restoration tests using approved test files or datasets. Verify that restored information is accessible and readable, document test results and report restoration failures. Ensure at least one documented restoration test is completed during the quarter.

title: Maintain an accurate and updated IT hardware inventory
description: Maintain an accurate record of all company-owned IT equipment, including computers, laptops, printers, servers, monitors, UPS units and network equipment. Record all purchases, assignments, transfers, repairs, replacements, retirements and disposals.

title: Complete scheduled computer and hardware preventive maintenance
description: Ensure all scheduled preventive maintenance activities are completed. Inspect and clean computers and peripherals, check ventilation, identify hardware faults and document maintenance performed on office equipment.

title: Maintain effective IT security monitoring and compliance
description: Conduct regular security monitoring, review endpoint protection alerts, identify suspicious activities, monitor security updates and ensure security incidents are reported and escalated according to organizational procedures.

title: Ensure all IT support requests and activities are documented
description: Ensure all IT support requests, troubleshooting activities, resolutions and escalations are recorded in the helpdesk or appropriate IT documentation system. Maintain clear records of issues, actions taken and outstanding follow-ups.

title: Maintain and monitor office network and Wi-Fi infrastructure
description: Regularly monitor the network management dashboard, connected access points, bandwidth utilization and signal interference. Ensure staff and guest Wi-Fi configurations remain operational and investigate connectivity issues promptly. Measured as: 100% of scheduled network monitoring checks completed.

title: Submit monthly IT maintenance and operations reports
description: Prepare and submit monthly IT reports covering user support, backups, hardware repairs, software updates, preventive maintenance, recurring incidents, outstanding issues and operational risks.

title: Maintain updated software inventory and licensing records
description: Review installed software, approved applications, software licenses and compatibility requirements. Ensure software inventory records are updated and licensing issues are identified and reported.

title: Ensure complete IT infrastructure and operational handover documentation
description: Ensure IT infrastructure documentation, server information, network configurations, backup procedures, equipment inventories, software records, vendor information, outstanding support issues and maintenance schedules are documented and accessible to authorized personnel. Ensure administrative credentials are transferred securely.

title: Ensure proper collection and accountability of IT equipment during employee offboarding
description: Ensure company-owned IT equipment is collected, recorded and secured whenever an employee leaves the organization. Coordinate account deactivation with authorized administrators and ensure equipment is prepared for reassignment or secure disposal.
